visualCharacteristics: Two large promotional pods side-by-side, each with a wide image, heading, description, and CTA button. Stacked on mobile, 2-up on desktop. Larger than cards-promo.
contentPattern: One row per pod (typically 2). Image cell (picture only) + body cell (heading + description + CTA link).
usage: Prominent 2-up feature promotions for major offers or campaigns.
